_comment: Response body for GET /api/site/overview, the endpoint app/page.tsx reads on mount.
That endpoint belongs to the fictional 'Tracepoint' product; this repo ships the
frontend only, so without it the page renders its error state and the metric strip
reads 'Status feed unreachable'. This file is the fixture screenshot.png was
captured against, committed so the image is reproducible rather than asserted.
Shape is fixed by the demo's own exported types: PlatformMetric (Hero.tsx, reused by
already declares the tier names and copy — only the price book crosses the network.
'metrics' is the hero's three headline readings; 'platform' is the four wider
counters in the strip beneath it. They are separate arrays because they answer
different questions, and the strip's lead figure takes a double-width track.

platform.label: Runs resumed mid-flight
platform.caption: after a deploy or a crash
